name: Shinguu Umanosuke
source:
Hobby: Painting

As a member of the Kaientai, he possesses white skin, which, however, turns red when he is laughed at. Therefore, he gained the nickname "Red-faced Umanosuke." He's liked painting since childhood.

[Edited from [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/baku.html]English official site[/url]]
